title: Emergency help in Ireland: call 112 or 999
description: In danger in Ireland? Call 112 or 999. How to text 112 if you cannot speak, how to tell them where you are, and other numbers to keep.
lede: If you or someone else is in danger, call 112 or 999 now. Both numbers work.

location.heading: Tell them where you are
list: Many smartphones send their location automatically when you contact 112. Do not rely on it.
Say your address, Eircode or a nearby landmark.
Not sure where you are? Tap the button below. Your phone shows your location so you can read it out.

sms.heading: Cannot speak? Text 112
list: You can text 112 from any Irish mobile number. A call is faster, so call if you can.
Say which service you need: Garda, Ambulance, Fire or Coast Guard.
Texts from a non-Irish mobile number do not reach 112.
Use plain letters. Special characters, such as fadas, may not show correctly.

numbers.name: Garda Confidential Line
numbers.sub: Give information about a crime. Not for emergencies.

numbers.name: Samaritans
numbers.sub: Someone to talk to, any time. Free from any phone.

numbers.name: Tourist SOS
numbers.sub: Help for visitors who are victims of crime. Mon to Sat 10am to 6pm, Sun and public holidays 12pm to 6pm.
